description_en: The monument is located on the side of the path between lake Rārā and Gamgadhi.The monument is a forest sanctuary (ban thān) dedicated to Mahādeva (Śiva). The god is represented by an uncarved stone located at the centre of the structure. The temple is composed of a large pillared veranda, oriented to the west. The façade's entablature is supported by carved and painted wooden pillars. On the south-eastern side is a carved wooden door leading to two small rooms. The general disposition is typical of other Mugu and Jumla District temples that are devoted to oracular consultations with meduims (dhāmī) (Unbescheid 1987: Pl 2).The walls are made of roughly cut stone. The roof is made of long board of wood.Oracular consultations with mediums may take place in the domestic place, as well as in sanctuaries outside settlements (Campbell 1978andYasuno 2018). In this latter case they are used only a few times to just once per year, during major full-moons. The exact details of worship at this sanctuary could not be recorded.Six bell stands in wood are installed in front of the monument. In front of the façade's central pillar is a pole with little flags hanging from it.
description_ne: यो मन्दिर रारा र गंगढिको बिचमा बाटोको नजिकै अवस्थित छ । यो वनक्षेत्रभित्र बनाइएको महादेवस्थान हो । मन्दिरभित्र कुन्नै बुट्टा अथवा आकृतिहरू नकुँदिकन राखिएको सादा ढुङ्गोलाई शिवको रूपमा पूज्ने गरिन्छ । मन्दिरको मोहडा भागलाई रङ्ग पोतिएका काठका खम्बाहरूले थामेका छन् । मन्दिरको दक्षिण पूर्वी मोहोडामा एउटा कलाकृतिहरू कुँदिएको काठको ढोका छ र यसबाट भित्र पसेपछि स-साना कोठाहरू देखिन्छ्न् । मन्दिरको भित्ताहरू काटिएका ढुङ्गाद्वारा बनाइएका छन्  र यसको छानो काठको फल्याकले छाइएको छ । मन्दिरको अगाडिपट्टि छ वटा काठले बनेका घण्टी झुण्ड्याउने स्तम्भहरू पनि छन् ।
